title: Dark Justiciar set
html:
The Dark Justiciar equipment is a set of armour themed after Shar's Dark Justiciars. Their bonuses revolve around being obscured.

Discoverable

These Dark Justiciar equipment pieces are significantly weaker but can be discovered around the world.

Name Slot Effect

Cracked Helm of Shar 		 Headgear (Medium Armour)
  • Constitution  Saving Throws +1

Damaged Dark Justiciar Armour 		 Armour (Medium Armour)

Dark Justiciar Gauntlets (Uncommon) 		 Gloves (Non-Armour)
  • Strength  Saving Throws +1
Umbral Attack
Your weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic damage.

Dark Justiciar Half-Plate (Rare) 		 Armour (Medium Armour)
  •  Advantage on Constitution  Saving Throws
 Shar's Aegis ()
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
Shar's Umbrae
While obscured, the wearer has  Advantage on Stealth Checks.

Dark Justiciar Helm 		 Headgear (Medium Armour)
Swathed in Shadow
While obscured by shadow, the wearer gains +1 to  Saving Throws when attacked.[See: Bugs]

Dark Justiciar Helmet 		 Headgear (Medium Armour)
Magical Durability
The wielder has a +1 bonus to  Saving throws against spells.
Covert Critical
While obscured, the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.
  • Constitution  Saving Throws +1

Dark Justiciar Mail 		 Armour (Medium Armour)
Nightsinger's Reply
While obscured by shadow, the wearer deals 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic damage to attackers that hit them with a melee attack.

Dark Justiciar Mask 		 Headgear (Light Armour)
  •  Intimidation +1

Justiciar's Greatshield 		 Off-Hand Melee (Shield)
 Darkness Cloak ()
Create a cloud of magical darkness and immediately attempt to  Hide. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
 Shield Blow ()
When a foe hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to knock it  Prone, unless they succeed a Strength saving throw.
  •  Advantage on Perception  Ability Checks.

Justiciar's Scimitar 		 Main Hand Melee (Scimitar)
Shadow-Blinding
If you attack with  Advantage, you have a chance to  Blind your target.[See: Bugs]
 Shadowsoaked Blow ()
Strike an enemy, adding your proficiency bonus to the damage. Moreover, if the attack hits, it deals an additional 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage. This attack doesn't break concealment. ( Recharge: Short rest.)

Shar Headwear 		 Headgear (Medium Armour)
  • Constitution  Saving Throws +1

Pristine

These pieces are pristine and have more powerful effects, but can only be received by becoming a Dark Justiciar.
